objective: Haptic feedback across cruush, behind one switch a member can turn off.
userOutcome: A press, a success, and a failure are felt in the hand; Haptic feedback in Settings turns all of it off.
successCriteria: Any touch on any control pulses once.
Success toasts pulse firmer; error and warning toasts pulse twice.
Haptic feedback off silences every pulse.
No effect on mouse, stylus, disabled controls, or browsers without the Vibration API.
mustPreserve: Every existing accessibility preference and its stored shape.
Every toast still raises exactly as before.
nonGoals: No change to the pre-sign-in accessibility quick panel.
No change to the Browse again button.

assumptions.statement: "go ahead" approves shipping the haptics work as presented, including the new Settings switch.
assumptions.impact: One new row in Settings > Accessibility.

nextVisibleMilestone: Haptic feedback switch on cruush.app Settings, pulses on Android.
stopConditions: Stop if the server build fails.
